Native HTML Elements

Details/Summary (Accordion)

What is html.style?

html.style is a modern CSS framework built on web standards. It uses OKLCH colors, container queries, and semantic HTML for the AI-native web of 2026.

How do container queries work?

Container queries allow components to adapt to their container's size rather than the viewport. This makes components truly portable and reusable.

Why OKLCH colors?

OKLCH provides perceptual uniformity, wide gamut support (Display P3), and accessibility by design through predictable contrast calculations.
